_comment: Open-ended corpora are stored in data/ because they are local preprocessed splits. Closed-form benchmarks are pulled from the Hub at run time and are therefore not stored here.

medquad_group_disjoint.note: Source/topic-disjoint repartition of MedQuAD: no (source document, focus entity) group appears in more than one partition, so the retrieval pool shares no topic or source document with the evaluated questions. Built by experiments/exp3_build_group_disjoint_split.py.

derived.medical_entities.json: BC5CDR chemical and disease vocabulary used when scispaCy is unavailable
